user-prompt-transformed.reason: Copilot transforms a submitted prompt into model-facing content; no portable event names that moment.

error-occurred.reason: Copilot's error event has no portable counterpart, and tool.error needs a tool invocation it does not carry.

notification-shell-completed.reason: Copilot's notification reports asynchronous status (a background shell completed, an agent went idle, a permission prompt); no portable event names it, and it is fire-and-forget.

notification-agent-idle.reason: Copilot's notification reports asynchronous status (a background shell completed, an agent went idle, a permission prompt); no portable event names it, and it is fire-and-forget.
